caption: The drawing depicts a single, intricately woven bag made from cord or thread, hanging vertically with a loosely twisted strap forming a loop at the top. The bag is rectangular, mostly monochrome in shades of gray, and showcases various woven and knotted patterns throughout its structure. The upper section contains vertical and diagonal woven ridges, while the middle and lower portions display densely packed geometric and lattice-like designs. The bag’s bottom edge is adorned with long, straight, and untangled fringe that hangs freely, creating a flowing appearance. The background of the drawing is plain and lightly textured, in an off-white or beige tone, providing contrast to the detailed dark outlines and intricate weave of the depicted object.
title: Handbag
